# Proverbs 24 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 24:3 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | By-wisdom a-house is-built, and-by-understanding it-is-established, |
| LOGOS | By wisdom a house is built, and by understanding it is established; |
| PNEUMA | A home is built by wisdom and made strong by understanding; |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
